reason: Conversation 1 correctly framed heat-pump dryers as cooler and slower from the outset, then asked the right questions (programme, filters, clothes dry at end, spin speed) and went on to correctly identify the 8-10 C garage and mid-cycle door opening as the main reasons for the 3.5 h cycles, recommended no parts, and reserved an engineer only for the case where a reduced load still fails a sensible test. Conversation 2 reached the right headline ('normal') but asked nothing, never confirmed the towels actually dry, and never surfaced the cold garage or door-opening factors that the homeowner needed to understand, nor the warranty route if a fault were shown. Conversation 1's odd 'switch it off and unplug it' line before a non-physical answer is a minor blemish, but overall it served the homeowner far better.
